tools.name: services.find_providers
tools.description: Use this when someone needs a plumber, an electrician or a phone repairer in Greater Accra, Ghana, and wants providers who have been confirmed by a person, with a number to call. tools.name: services.areas
tools.description: Use this when you need to know which trades and which districts of Greater Accra the list of confirmed service providers covers, and how many are listed, before searching it. Do not use it to find a provider: use services.find_providers for that.
